dashboard.title: Welcome back, {{name}}
dashboard.subtitle: Your assigned cohorts at a glance. Each figure opens the matching roster.
dashboard.panelNote: Named demo learners only. Excused sessions are not counted as absences.
dashboard.followUpBody: Missed sessions, support reminders and quiz support requests.
dashboard.noFollowUpBody: Everyone is on track. Absences and reminders will appear here.
dashboard.gradingBody: Practical submissions waiting for your rubric review.
dashboard.appsBody: Applications waiting for a decision: {{count}}. Review profiles and assign accepted learners to your cohort.

applications.title: Training applications
applications.subtitle: Applications to the programmes your cohorts run. Review each profile, record a decision and assign accepted learners.
applications.emptyBody: New registrations that apply to your programme will appear here for screening.
applications.noneInTabBody: Choose another status or show all applications.
applications.generalLearning: General self-paced learning stays available while an application is pending or waitlisted. Cohort sessions open only after assignment.
applications.assignPrompt: Accepted. Assign to {{cohort}} to open its restricted sessions.
applications.inCohort: Assigned to {{cohort}}. Cohort sessions are now visible to this learner.

cohorts.title: My cohorts
cohorts.subtitle: Roster, progress, attendance, assessment status and practical submissions for your assigned cohorts only.
cohorts.emptyBody: Accept a training application and assign the learner to your cohort to see them here.
cohorts.noMatchBody: Clear or change a filter to see more learners.
cohorts.note: Progress covers the cohort courses. Attendance rate counts Present against Present plus Absent; Excused is shown separately.

learner.subtitle: Chronological training record and the next support action.
learner.noRecordBody: Attendance, completed courses and reviews will appear here in date order.

missed.title: Follow up on a missed session
missed.body: Contact the learner, share the session materials and agree how to catch up.

review.title: Review the submitted practical
review.body: A practical task is waiting for your rubric review and feedback.

quiz.title: Offer quiz support
quiz.body: Both demo quiz attempts were used without a pass. Suggest a unit to revisit.

recommend.title: Recommend for certification
recommend.body: All requirements are met. Recommend the certificate for centre approval.

assign.title: Assign to a cohort
assign.body: The learner is not in a cohort yet. Review the training application.

continue.title: Encourage the next unit
continue.body: The learner is on track. Check the next course requirement together.

sessions.title: Sessions and attendance
sessions.subtitle: Sessions for your cohorts only. Open a session to record attendance and add a follow-up note.
sessions.emptyBody: Create a sample session for your cohort to start recording attendance.
sessions.sampleNote: All schedules are sample data, not booked sessions. Online sessions open a demo room; no live meeting is created.
sessions.attentionBody: Learners marked absent in a past session. Open the session to add a follow-up note.

stat.toMarkHint: Past sessions with learners not yet marked

form.body: Sessions are saved in this demonstration only. Times are Syria time.
form.lockedNote: This is a scheduled sample session: its title, cohort and time are fixed. You can update the room or joining placeholder, resources and assignment.
form.title: Session title
form.errTime: The end time must be after the start time.

register.title: Attendance register
register.body: Mark each learner individually or mark everyone present. Present earns attendance points once.
register.empty: No learners in this cohort yet
register.emptyBody: Assign accepted applicants to the cohort to build the register.

toast.absent: {{name}} marked absent. A support reminder was created.

note.title: Follow-up note
note.label: Brief note for the cohort record
note.placeholder: e.g. Share the slides with absent learners and check in before the next session.

assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.subtitle: Practical submissions from your learners. Score each with the sample rubric and give feedback.
assessments.emptyBody: When a learner submits a practical task it appears here for review.
assessments.rubricNote: The rubric is proposed sample content: three criteria scored 0 to 2. A score of at least 4 out of 6 meets the demo task threshold.

understands.label: Understands the request
understands.hint: Identifies what the customer or client needs

clear.label: Clear response
clear.hint: Polite, concise and easy to follow

review.title: Review: {{course}}
review.feedbackPlaceholder: What worked well, and one thing to improve.
review.errFeedback: Add feedback so the learner knows what to revise.

resources.title: Learning resources
resources.subtitle: Course materials for your cohorts. Link a resource and a task to a course or to the whole cohort.
resources.emptyBody: Use the form to attach a template and a task to a course or cohort.
resources.taskPlaceholder: e.g. Complete the worksheet before S03
resources.libraryNote: From the programme's shared template library. Learners in the chosen class see it on My Cohort and Sessions.

results.title: Results and certificates
results.subtitle: Quiz score, practical review and completion prerequisites for each cohort course.
results.flowNote: You recommend; the centre administrator approves and issues.
results.missingQuiz: Final quiz not passed yet (80% needed)
results.notEligible: Not yet eligible. Complete the missing items first.
results.emptyBody: Results appear once learners are assigned to your cohort.

clear.label: Clear and organised
clear.hint: Easy to follow, with the key points first

nextStep.label: Specific and realistic
nextStep.hint: Uses concrete actions, examples or evidence the learner could really use
